d.d: A stiff flour pudding, often with dried fruit, boiled in a cloth bag, or steamed.
A pudding-style dessert, especially one made with plums or (in the Bahamas) guavas.

d.x: Why do I always get a shopping trolley with duff wheels?

d.d: To alter the branding of stolen cattle; to steal cattle.
To hit the ground behind the ball.
A kind of coarse woolen cloth, having a thick nap or frieze.
comparative form of duff: more duff
An incompetent, indolent, or clumsy person.
A player having little skill, especially a golfer who duffs.
A racing pigeon that does not perform well.
